verdicts.title: Motivic Steenrod operations in characteristic $p$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Using the recent work of Frankland and Spitzweck, we define Steenrod operations $P^{n}$ on the mod $p$ motivic cohomology of smooth varieties defined over a base field of characteristic $p$. We show that $P^{n}$ is the $p$th power on $H^{2n,n}(-,\mathbb{F}_{p})\cong CH^{n}(-)/p$ and prove an instability result for the operations. verdicts.title: Heights and quadratic forms: on Cassels' theorem and its generalizations
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this survey paper, we discuss the classical Cassels' theorem on existence of small-height zeros of quadratic forms over Q and its many extensions, to different fields and rings, as well as to more general situations, such as existence of totally isotropic small-height subspaces. verdicts.title: Universal quadratic forms and Whitney tower intersection invariants
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
The first part of this paper exposits a simple geometric description of the Kirby-Siebenmann invariant of a 4--manifold in terms of a quadratic refinement of its intersection form.
